1) **The email** on your order (or your **first name + last name + ZIP**), and  
2) Your **order ID** (it usually looks like **#W0000000**).

Once I have that, I’ll look up the order and confirm the exact **item IDs** and available **replacement variants** (keyboard: clicky switches; thermostat: Google Home instead of Apple HomeKit), and then I’ll ask for your confirmation and payment method before submitting the exchange.
Sure! My name is Yusuf Rossi and my zip code is 19122. The order ID is #W2378156. Let me know if you need anything else to get started.
